problems.title: An ellipse’s largest inscribed circle passes through its foci
problems.question: The largest circle inscribed in an ellipse passes through both foci. Find the ratio of major to minor semiaxes.
problems.idea: The largest inscribed circle has radius equal to the minor semiaxis b.
formulas: Its centre is the ellipse centre; focus distance c=b; a²=b²+c².

problems.title: The largest symmetric triangle with a focal base midpoint
problems.question: An isosceles triangle in x²/16+y²/9=1 is symmetric about the x-axis and has its base midpoint at a focus. Find its greatest possible area.
problems.idea: The focus fixes the vertical base chord. Choose the opposite ellipse vertex for the greatest height.
steps: The base length is 9/2. The opposite vertex is (−4,0), distance 4+√7 from that base.

problems.title: Intersections of two shifted parabolas
problems.question: For which p do y²=2px and (y−3)²=2px have at least one common point?
problems.idea: Equate the left sides.
steps: For p≠0, x=y²/(2p)=9/(8p), so there is exactly one intersection.
For p=0, the equations give separate lines y=0 and y=3, with no common point.

problems.title: Identify a hyperbola from one vertex and asymptote
problems.question: Which listed hyperbola has vertex (0,0) and asymptote y=√2x+√2?
problems.idea: Complete squares in the candidate equation.
steps: Its centre is (−1,0), vertices (0,0),(−2,0), and asymptotes y=±√2(x+1).

problems.title: Foci do not fix a rectangle’s height
problems.question: An axis-aligned rectangle has opposite-side midpoints equal to the foci of x²/16−y²/9=1. Find its perimeter.
problems.idea: The foci fix only one rectangle dimension.
formulas: c=√(16+9)=5, so the focus separation is 10.
steps: The rectangle can have vertical sides at x=−5 and x=5, with any positive height h centred on y=0.
Its perimeter is 2(10+h), which varies with h.

problems.title: A circle enclosing four equal circles
problems.question: Find the circle internally tangent to all four circles of radius 1 centred at (±1,±1).
problems.idea: Symmetry places the enclosing circle centre at the origin.

problems.title: A plane parallel to the z-axis
problems.question: A plane is parallel to the z-axis and cuts positive x,y intercepts forming a right isosceles triangle with the origin, with legs 1. Find its equation.
problems.idea: The two intercepts are (1,0,0),(0,1,0).
formulas: Intercept form x/1+y/1=1; no z term for a plane parallel to the z-axis.

problems.title: Which points lie between parallel planes?
problems.question: For planes 2x+4y−7z+16=0 and 2x+4y−7z+4=0, which of A=(1,1,1),B=(1,1,2),C=(2,1,2),D=(2,2,−1) lie between them?
problems.idea: Evaluate the common linear form s=2x+4y−7z.
steps: Only −8 and −6 lie in the interval.

problems.title: A parallel plane a fixed distance from the origin
problems.question: Find a plane parallel to x+y−z+5√3=0 and distance 5 from the origin.
problems.idea: Keep the same normal and solve for the constant.
formulas: For x+y−z+D=0, distance to the origin=|D|/√3.
steps: Thus D=±5√3. One is the original plane; the other, distinct parallel plane is x+y−z−5√3=0.
problems.answer: The distinct listed plane is x+y−z−5√3=0.
problems.note: If coincident planes count as parallel, the original plane also satisfies the distance condition.

problems.title: An insphere in an orthogonal tetrahedron
problems.question: A triangular pyramid has a right isosceles base with legs 1. Its height is 1 at the right-angle vertex. Find the inradius.
problems.idea: Its three perpendicular edges from one vertex all have length 1.
formulas: V=1/6; three face areas=1/2 each; opposite face area=√3/2; r=3V/S_total.

problems.title: A distance to a tilted triangle plane
problems.question: A right prism has base AB=5,AC=3√2,BC=7. M is on AA₁ with AM=4. Find distance from A to plane MBC.
problems.idea: Use a tetrahedron volume computed with two different bases.
formulas: Base triangle area=21/2; its altitude from A to BC is 3.
steps: The base area follows from cos A=(25+18−49)/(2·5·3√2)=−1/(5√2), or Heron’s formula.
The distance from M to BC is √(3²+4²)=5, so area MBC=7·5/2=35/2.
Using MBC as base, the desired height is 3·14/(35/2).

problems.title: A cylinder chord section and an oblique segment
problems.question: A,B lie on different base circles of a cylinder of radius 5. A plane through AB parallel to the axis is distance 4 from the axis. AB makes 45° with the base. Find AB.
problems.idea: The plane cuts a rectangle whose horizontal width is a base chord.
steps: Because A and B lie on different base circles in this section and the segment is not vertical, they are opposite rectangle corners.
The horizontal projection of AB is 6. With inclination 45°, AB=6/cos45°.

problems.title: Differentiate the given derivative
problems.question: f′(x)=4x+sin x and f(0)=2. Find f″(π/3).
problems.idea: The initial function value is unnecessary for a second derivative.

problems.title: An exponential difference quotient
problems.question: Find limₓ→₀[e^{5+2x}−e⁵]/x.
problems.idea: It is the derivative at zero of e^{5+2x}.

problems.title: An exponential meets a logarithm
problems.question: Find the distance from the origin to the intersection of y=2ˣ and y=log₃(−√3x).
problems.idea: Try x=−1, then use monotonicity for uniqueness.
steps: On x<0, 2ˣ increases while log₃(−√3x) decreases, so no second intersection exists.
Its distance to the origin is √(1+1/4).

problems.title: Maximum product under a linear constraint
problems.question: If 5a+6b=2, find the greatest possible ab.
problems.idea: Use a nonnegative square, without assuming signs.

problems.title: Add two trigonometric extrema
problems.question: Find max(2sin³x+3cos x)+min(cos2x+cos x).
problems.idea: Find each extremum separately.
formulas: For the first, derivative=3sin x(sin2x−1). For the second, put c=cos x: 2c²+c−1=2(c+1/4)²−9/8.
steps: The first derivative is nonpositive on [0,π] and nonnegative on [π,2π]. By periodicity its maximum is at x=0, value 3.
The second function reaches −9/8 at cos x=−1/4.

problems.title: A cubic’s minimum input is independent of its constant
problems.question: Find the local-minimum input of y=x³−3x²−9x+a−2.
problems.idea: The parameter only shifts the graph vertically.
steps: The derivative changes from negative to positive at x=3.
At x=−1 it changes the other way and gives a local maximum.

problems.title: Continuity of a piecewise function
problems.question: For which a is y=x²+x+a for x<8 and y=∛x+1 for x≥8 continuous everywhere?
problems.idea: Only the joining input x=8 needs checking.

problems.title: A tangent to an exponential product
problems.question: Find the tangent to y=xe^{x−1} at (1,1).
problems.idea: Use the product rule.

problems.title: A variable logarithm base reverses an inequality
problems.question: Solve logₓ(4x²)≤1.
problems.idea: Separate 0<x<1 from x>1; x=1 is forbidden.
steps: The first case has no solution because x>1.
The second gives x≥1/4, still below 1.

problems.title: A product derivative at a sine zero
problems.question: Find $f\prime(\pi)$ for $f(x)=\sin x\,e^{1/\cos^2x}$.
problems.idea: At x=π the product-rule term containing sin x vanishes.

problems.title: Area enclosed by a parabola, a line and the x-axis
problems.question: Find the bounded region using y=x²,y=2−x and the x-axis near their nonnegative intercepts.
problems.idea: Split at the positive parabola-line intersection.
formulas: x²=2−x gives x=1 or −2; the relevant positive intersection is (1,1).
steps: From x=0 to 1 the upper boundary over the x-axis is x²; from 1 to 2 it is 2−x.
problems.answer: 5/6 for the region whose boundary uses all three curves near the nonnegative intercepts.

problems.title: Integrate a polynomial times a square root
problems.question: Find $\int x\sqrt{2x-1}\,dx$.
problems.idea: Set u=2x−1.

problems.title: A cubic increasing on a given interval
problems.question: Which listed function increases on (−3,4)?
problems.idea: Check the derivative over the full interval.
steps: Thus it is strictly increasing throughout the interval.
